description:
Open the presentation file 'acme_annual_review.pptx' which is already loaded in LibreOffice Impress. Navigate to Slide 3 titled 'Leadership Team' (currently empty except for the title). On this slide, create an organizational chart using shapes (rectangles) and connecting lines to display the following company hierarchy:

1. Maria Chen — CEO (top of chart)
2. David Park — VP Engineering (reports to Maria Chen)
3. Lisa Thompson — VP Marketing (reports to Maria Chen)
4. Michael Brown — VP Operations (reports to Maria Chen)
5. Sarah Johnson — Dev Lead (reports to David Park)
6. Robert Garcia — Brand Manager (reports to Lisa Thompson)

Each person should be a rectangle shape containing their name and title. Draw connecting lines between shapes to show reporting relationships (at least 5 connections). Arrange the chart hierarchically: CEO at top, VPs in the middle row, and managers at the bottom.

After creating the org chart, save the file with Ctrl+S. The file can be saved in either .pptx or .odp format.
